s1_watch.operationalization: eligible weekly TDCC transition with margin_change < 0 and dBig1000 > 0; PIT availability = ReferenceDate + 7 calendar days

whale_surprise_rank.definition: cross-sectional percentile rank of dBig1000 within the same TDCC snapshot

descriptive_recent_s1_top_quintile.note: quintile is descriptive, not a hard threshold

s2_capture_confirmation.test_operationalization: after an S1 WATCH, wait for the next observable weekly TDCC transition and require Big1000 not to unwind (next dBig1000 >= 0)
s2_capture_confirmation.observed_lead_character: typically 0-2 trading days before activation among captured recent examples
s2_capture_confirmation.reason: Weekly ownership reporting resolves too slowly; market activation can occur before a second ownership snapshot becomes PIT-eligible. Requiring S2 would destroy useful recall and lead time with little precision gain.

state_machine_observability_rule.rule: Observed state sequence may skip S2_CAPTURE in real time when S3_ACTIVATION occurs before the next TDCC confirmation. S2 remains a confidence/confirmation state, not a mandatory prerequisite for BUY research.

current_v2_decision.reason_no_1y: The recent-3M WATCH layer survives, but the full WATCH->BUY->HOLD->SELL lifecycle has not yet demonstrated superior executable performance; do not use 1Y to rescue or complete an unfinished 3M challenger.
